name: MolDraw
tierReason: Its standalone editor produces styled 2D structures, reaction schemes, and publication-size SVG and PNG figures.
summary: MolDraw is a browser editor for chemical structures, reaction schemes, mechanisms, and publication figures.

license.text: Free core drawing with paid Pro features; not open source.

price.text: Free tier; Pro US$99/year including tax (2026-11-05; country pricing varies).

caveats: Saving or exporting drawings containing Templates content or lab apparatus requires Pro.
Office editing requires reopening the exported picture in MolDraw and replacing it.
Free users are asked to credit MolDraw; Pro removes this request.

observations: Caffeine appeared with aromatic circles in the default SMILES layout.
Paclitaxel default 2D layout contained overlapping bonds.
Paclitaxel displayed SMILES differed from input at one stereocenter; connectivity matched.
Cholesterol 3D bonds appeared elongated in headless Chromium, including after SDF import.
Downloads and Copy SMILES prompted for an account; molecule details displayed SMILES.
Current paclitaxel SMILES layout overlapped; MOL import displayed a clear drawing.
A later cholesterol SMILES import produced a normally proportioned, rotatable 3D model.
Publisher homepage application metadata declares softwareVersion 4.0.
Paclitaxel remained stretched at 5, 30, 60 and 120 seconds; UFF stayed 24338.7 kcal/mol.
Headed Chrome also showed stretched paclitaxel with UFF 24338.7 kcal/mol.
Cholesterol headless model stayed normally proportioned at 5, 30, 60 and 120 seconds; UFF stayed 63.3 kcal/mol.
Headed Chrome cholesterol model remained stretched, with UFF 115.2 kcal/mol unchanged over the comparison.
Original paclitaxel SMILES overlapped through toolbar but drew cleanly through canvas paste.
Canvas and command-palette imports displayed no stereochemical wedges for paclitaxel.
Stereo-free paclitaxel produced a clean toolbar layout.

builtOn.note: Custom canvas; Indigo optionally supplies 2D layout; OpenChemLib handles structure processing.

thirdParty.summary: Includes Apache-2.0 (Indigo), BSD-3-Clause (OpenChemLib), and OFL-1.1 fonts (Libre Franklin; font derivatives retain OFL).
